LAURUSLABS.NS.headline: Laurus Labs exhibits powerful Stage 2 momentum and strong relative strength near 52-week highs.
LAURUSLABS.NS.technical_summary: Robust uptrend with price above all key EMAs, elite Mansfield Relative Strength, and positive net volume accumulation, though short-term momentum is overbought.
